description: OFAC sanctions screening for crypto wallet addresses: exact match against every digital currency address on the U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, TRX, SOL, LTC, XMR and more). Useful for compliance and AML checks before paying a counterparty or an x402 payTo. Up to 20 comma-separated addresses; returns sanctioned true/false, SDN name, programs, official link and list freshness. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sanctions/address.

address.description: crypto address, or up to 20 comma-separated

name: sanctions_address_check
title: OFAC sanctions check for crypto addresses
